$comment: Shimla mein jo gaadiyan asli mein chalti hain. handling values arcade hain, simulation nahi - pahadi sadak pe mazedaar lagni chahiye. 'shape' web/src/vehicle.js ko batata hai kaunsa silhouette banana hai. NOTE: Alto/Baleno Maruti Suzuki ke, Thar Mahindra ka trademark hai - public release se pehle naam badalne padenge (design/08-legal-and-attribution.md dekho).

vehicles.name: Shimla Taxi (Alto)
vehicles.desc: Peeli-kaali local taxi. Shimla mein zyadatar Alto hi taxi hoti hai - chhoti, tang galiyon mein ghus jaati hai.

vehicles.name: Alto
vehicles.desc: Sheher ki sabse aam gaadi. Ooncha roof, chhota footprint, aur har mod pe ghoom jaati hai.

vehicles.name: Maruti 800
vehicles.desc: Purane Shimla ki gaadi. Dheemi, seedhi lakeerein, aur abhi bhi galiyon mein khadi milti hai.

vehicles.name: Baleno
vehicles.desc: Naya Shimla. Lambi, dhalaan wali chhat, Cart Road pe sabse tez.

vehicles.name: Thar
vehicles.desc: Pahad ke liye sabse sahi. Khada windshield, bade tyre, peeche spare wheel - kacchi sadak pe bhi nahi rukti.

vehicles.name: Scooter
vehicles.desc: Sanjauli ki tang galiyon ka raja. Mall Road pe bhi nikal jaati hai.

vehicles.name: HRTC Bus
vehicles.desc: Himachal Road Transport. Bhaari, dheemi, par pahad pe rukti nahi. Guru ki jaan.

vehicles.name: Timber Truck
vehicles.desc: Deodar ke latthe laadta hai. Kaagaz kabhi poore nahi hote.

vehicles.name: HP Police Gypsy
vehicles.desc: Himachal Police. Halki aur phurtili - pahadi mod pe tumse tez.

vehicles.name: Lalit Travels
vehicles.desc: Neeli-safed private bus. Shimla-Dhalli-Kufri route pe roz chalti hai.

vehicles.name: Krishna Travels
vehicles.desc: Laal-kreem private bus. Sanjauli se Chhota Shimla aur Khalini.

vehicles.name: Rajdhani Express
vehicles.desc: Peeli-maroon deluxe. Lambi doori -- Shimla se Delhi raat bhar.

vehicles.name: IGMC Ambulance
vehicles.desc: IGMC ki ambulance. Sanjauli se hospital tak ka rasta yahi roz naapti hai.
